concerns.text: FR-008 mandates Network-Based Statistic (NBS) analysis, which was not part of the original research question in the idea. Adding NBS expands the scope beyond the stated aim of assessing functional connectivity differences and correlations with musical training.

The specification imposes a hard memory limit of ≤7 GB RAM and a runtime ceiling of 6 hours on a 2‑core CPU (see US‑1 acceptance scenario). These engineering constraints were not mentioned in the idea and constitute an over‑reach unless explicitly justified as necessary for feasibility.
